recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-47282 clarification without expanding into a full FHIR-47280 terminology sweep; any remaining lower-case actor terminology should be handled separately if that issue is reconciled.
issue_request: FHIR-47282 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requested replacing wording that implied an active Subscription resource sends notifications with wording that says the Subscription Provider relies on Bundle and SubscriptionStatus for notifications related to active Subscriptions.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git commit 63e647c48f287395f2ee0e9921c9333cc41aac47, linked from Jira via HL7/fhir#3967. That commit removed the clearly wrong sentence but left the target text as "The Subscription provider", preserving resource formatting instead of using the approved actor term.
additional_context: FHIR-47280 was approved in the same FHIR-I Subscriptions block vote and added the Subscription terminology disambiguation glossary. The current page defines "Subscription Provider" as the actor that implements the Subscription Framework and sends notifications, and says role names are capitalized. No relevant Zulip discussion was found that changes this Jira/source/git conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscriptions.html so the sentence now begins "The Subscription Provider relies..." while preserving the existing Bundle and SubscriptionStatus links and active-subscriptions qualifier.
source_changes: source/subscriptions.html: replaced "The Subscription provider" with "The Subscription Provider" in the Boundaries and Relationships notification sentence.
